To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
neural networks can be used for indoor localization in a highly aggressive environment, using fingerprinting-based localization and UWB as the wireless physical propagation medium.
neural network-based fingerprinting-localization using UWB can provide good accuracy and precision in an underground environment, even in the presence of NLOS and multipath.

1) the neural networks are very useful in indoor localization, especially when combined with fingerprinting; 2) the neural networks can be used to compensate the errors in the localization due to NLOS propagation; 3) the RBFs are better than the MLPs in terms of accuracy and precision; 4) in a LOS environment, the MLPs are as accurate as the RBFs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of NN to improve the overall performance of the system in terms of accuracy, precision and robustness.
the development of a robust, reliable and low-cost indoor localization system for the use in underground environments such as mines.
the use of ultra-wideband (UWB) radio signals for indoor localization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
neural networks are a good candidate for the localization system.
, neural networks have a significant and important role to play in improving the performance of the overall system, especially in the presence of NLOS propagation.
the proposed neural-network-based fingerprinting-geolocalization system is able to achieve good localization results in an underground environment using UWB.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have used neural networks in order to improve the accuracy and the precision of the final localization system, and we have shown the superiority of the RBF over the MLP.
we are trying to use the neural networks to enhance the performance of a fingerprinting-based UWB indoor localization system.
this paper presents a new approach to the problem of localization in mines, which is a highly challenging environment for any localization system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
neural networks can play an important role in the development of reliable and accurate localization systems.
NN can be used to improve the performance of fingerprinting-based indoor localization using UWB.
the proposed system is capable to provide accurate localization with high reliability in underground environments, which is the main target of this research.
